name: Ổ đĩa mềm
description: Ổ đĩa mềm bên trong máy tính, khe trống, ảnh kim loại ngả tím.

origin.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated vintage internal 3.5-inch desktop floppy disk drive, viewed from slightly above and directly in front, broad rectangular light silver-gray metal body with a clean horizontal front slot, small eject button and tiny activity LED. No disk inserted. Entire drive visible. Printed black-and-white photographic cutout with a restrained violet duotone in shadows, fine halftone texture, narrow irregular white cut-paper contour. Contemporary Pop editorial collage, not a vector drawing, not 3D clay. No text, labels or logos. No external cast shadow, no hands or surrounding computer. Actual transparent alpha background and generous transparent margins.
